body.name: \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_{\mathrm{end}}(Y_0,Y_1)\)
body.construction: In the specialization \(N=3,r=s=1\), first compute \(\widehat h(Y_0)\) from \(\mathcal E_4(T_0)\). Then enumerate the empty support and the three singleton supports and return \(\widehat{\mathcal C}_{\mathrm{end}}=\{b\in[-B,B]^3:\lVert b\rVert_0\le1,\ \exists m'\in\operatorname{range}(P_{\widehat h}),\ \lVert m'\rVert_2\le A,\ \lVert z-m'-b\rVert_2\le\varepsilon_1\}\).
